name: himalayas-deals-mcp
description: Himalayas (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET https://himalayas.app/jobs/api/search (q free text, page 1-based, sort; also country, worldwide, seniority, employment_type, company, timezone). `query` → q; `category` → employment_type (one of Full Time, Part Time, Contractor, Temporary, Intern, Volunteer, Other — use Contractor for freelance/contract gigs); newest first (sort=recent). Pages hold 20 jobs (the documented maximum), so limit is not sent. min_budget is not sent (no salary filter). budget_min/budget_max are the salary range (salaryPeriod in raw, often annual), skills = categories, description = excerpt (full HTML in raw.description); pubDate/expiryDate are Unix seconds in raw. Attribution: link back to the Himalayas URL and name Himalayas as the source.
